results.description:
A mistletoe. A kiss.
This just might be the start of a beautiful Christmas.
 
Theresa doesn’t make the best pot of coffee in their small town, but people still flock to the diner for a cup, even Officer Aiden Crowl, who rarely displays a smile since his fiancé died. She knows she’ll never be able to win his heart, but it’s hard to keep her emotions in check, especially when he kisses her under the mistletoe. Well, on the cheek, but that has to count for something…right?

Staying busy keeps Aiden sane. Because when he’s idle or alone, he thinks, and nothing good comes from that. Everyone believes he’s the perfect man. They assume he’s broken because she’s gone. He is, just not for the reason they imagine. Every time he walks into the diner, one sweet smile from Theresa erases some of the pain. He should stay away from her. Far away. But what is he supposed to do when they’re standing under the mistletoe? Kiss her, of course.
 
Get swept into the holiday magic with this angsty, yet heartwarming friends to lovers novel today! Discover if Aiden can overcome the past to build a future with Theresa.
